info.title: Classroom OS Web Alpha API
info.description: PR-03b S2 review candidate; not an implemented or approved service. API prefix remains /api/web/v1. S1 approves experimental inputs only; production parameters, implementation, real enrollment and deployment remain gated. Private and secret responses are no-store; business ownership, unknown-charge and existing idempotency/secret-replay semantics remain in force.

get.description: Resource ownership, tombstones and active account checked on the server. See 04-CONTRACTS-FLOWS.md for transaction semantics.

default.description: Typed failure; no private content in error messages.

get.description: Creates/refreshes random preauth-session cookie and bound CSRF token; same-origin no-store; Origin/Fetch-Metadata checked. Authenticated callers obtain token bound to current session. Secret-bearing response is never stored in operation_receipts. Recheck identity, authorization, epochs and expiry before reissuing; never replay old key/cookie/ticket. A valid automatic recovery cookie selects only its own restricted CSRF/receiver challenge; ordinary session, preauth and recovery material cannot substitute. Expired/consumed recovery cookie is not a terminal-status credential.

default.description: Typed failure; no private content in error messages.

post.description: Resource ownership, tombstones and active account checked on the server. See 04-CONTRACTS-FLOWS.md for transaction semantics. New password uses Student min 6/Admin min 12 from trusted server role and Unicode code-point rules; local approved list mandatory. If none valid, 503 SERVICE_DISABLED retryable true without reset/reauth consumption or success receipt; do not disable normal login or send password plaintext to a provider.

post.description: Resource ownership, tombstones and active account checked on the server. See 04-CONTRACTS-FLOWS.md for transaction semantics. Secret-bearing response is never stored in operation_receipts. Recheck identity, authorization, epochs and expiry before reissuing; never replay old key/cookie/ticket. factor_type is mandatory. totp can complete full authentication; recovery_code must verify receiver PoP, consume one code and return recovery_required only. Its password challenge, account/credential epoch and budgets must remain valid; if a consumed recovery-code request loses its secret response, never blindly consume another code or replay a cap; require separately reviewed fresh authorization.

post.description: Resource ownership, tombstones and active account checked on the server. See 04-CONTRACTS-FLOWS.md for transaction semantics. Secret-bearing response is never stored in operation_receipts. Recheck identity, authorization, epochs and expiry before reissuing; never replay old key/cookie/ticket. Strict operation binding is mandatory; server derives risk and authorization, verifies current factors, computes an internal keyed canonical-parameter commitment, and never returns or logs low-entropy password SHA/candidate body. Student recovery purposes merely bridge a proof to an independently authorized local broker, never execute public issue/complete/status. The raw-body S2 candidate is 32 KiB here only because current and candidate passwords can both be present.

post.description: Resource ownership, tombstones and active account checked on the server. See 04-CONTRACTS-FLOWS.md for transaction semantics. Secret is displayed only in first response, never saved in generic receipts. Lost-response retry returns 409 SECRET_ALREADY_ISSUED; reauthenticate then explicitly rotate/reissue with new operation, invalidating old secret. Separate proof bound to enrollment and code/body; first Student enrollment R2, existing-factor replacement R3. Ordinary enrollment only; never manual/automatic recovery final. Its existing RecoveryCodes first-response contract applies to ordinary enrollment only; it must reject recovery cookies and manual receiver contexts rather than act as recovery finalize.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-classroom_session
sessionCookie.description: Full server-validated session only; preauth and restricted recovery cookies are not accepted here. Secure; HttpOnly; Path=/; SameSite=Lax; no Domain. Recheck current user/session/device/epoch and idle/absolute expiry. Token producer uses at least 32 random bytes encoded canonical unpadded base64url, 43..256 characters, accepted unchanged by control ActorSessionEvidence.Secret; decoder rejects noncanonical or insufficient-byte values.

recoveryCookie.name: __Host-classroom_recovery
recoveryCookie.description: Independent opaque HttpOnly/Secure/Path=/;SameSite=Lax cookie with no Domain. Only an automatic recovery flow, current target epoch and pre-registered receiver P-256 key; never a sessionCookie or manual control credential. Digest only in PG; no terminal-status or secret-replay authority.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Bound to the specific full session, public preauth or restricted recovery context selected by the route; these contexts cannot substitute for one another. Browser writes also require exact configured Origin/Fetch Metadata.

ReauthToken.name: X-Reauth-Token
ReauthToken.description: Existing X-Reauth-Token header, carrying an opaque server-issued proof for the exact purpose, target, candidate parameters and future Idempotency-Key. R3 at most 120 seconds from real verified_at and single-use; R1/R2 use the documented role window. Recheck current session/device/epoch and deadline after all locks. This header cannot grant ordinary admin permissions or authorize an unreviewed operation. Producer generates at least 32 random bytes, canonical unpadded base64url, 43..256 characters; parser decodes/re-encodes and rejects noncanonical or insufficient-byte values. Same token is accepted by control StudentExecutorEvidence via its Secret envelope; shape alone does not prove entropy or authorization.

password.description: New password: 6-1024 Unicode code points for Student; server-derived Admin role requires at least 12. No composition requirement, trimming, normalization or truncation. Local approved password list required. Public schema minimum 6 never authorizes an Admin short password.

RegisterRequest.description: Invitation-only Student registration; no client role field. Local password policy/list and PR-03a capacity/invitation atomicity remain server-authoritative.

CsrfBootstrap.description: Protocol defense material only. With a valid automatic recovery cookie, csrf_token belongs only to that flow and receiver_challenge is present; no full-session or terminal-status grant. Ordinary/preauth responses omit receiver_challenge. Refreshing protocol material never extends session/proof/flow deadlines or performs recovery business changes.

password.description: Verify existing PHC; do not apply new-password minimum. Local-list unavailability does not disable normal login.

remember_me.description: Student: true persistent cookie, false session cookie; both retain server 14-day idle/30-day absolute. Admin: always non-persistent and server 15-minute idle/8-hour absolute.

oneOf.description: Only after full required password/MFA validation; returns a new full-session cookie and untrusted device context.
No full-session cookie or business principal. receiver_challenge permits proof of the recovery receiver key if a recovery code is chosen; it is not authentication.
Password plus single-use recovery code only; ordinary fields stay null. Old clients must reject this unknown state, never coerce it to authenticated.

LoginResult.description: Disjoint strict results. mfa_required/recovery_required cannot carry a User, device or ordinary CSRF. Only authenticated establishes a normal session. Unknown states fail closed in all clients.

oneOf.description: Current TOTP only; no recovery-code fallback under this discriminator.
Explicit recovery code and receiver-key proof; atomically consume one code and create only an automatic rebind flow. Never issue a normal session or admin principal.

ReauthRequest.description: Password is always current verification, not a new-password policy check. mfa_code may be omitted only by a Student without an enrolled factor; Admin/enrolled Student must prove current TOTP. Recovery code is not an ordinary reauth factor. Candidate new password is TLS input for server commitment only and must not enter logs/receipts.

ReauthResult.description: Opaque proof plus fixed server expiry only; no plaintext candidate parameters or public password fingerprint. R1 max Student 600s/Admin 300s; R2 max 300s; R3 and Student-recovery bridge max 120s from actual factor verified_at, then intersect proof/session/device/permission deadlines. R3 and recovery writes single-use; recovery_status read-only proof reusable only while valid, never consumes recovery nonce/cap. Token encoding is canonical unpadded base64url from at least 32 random bytes, 43..256 characters, identical to X-Reauth-Token and the control bridge; decoder enforces canonical encoding and byte minimum.

new_password.description: New password: 6-1024 Unicode code points for Student; server-derived Admin role requires at least 12. No composition requirement, trimming, normalization or truncation. Local approved password list required. Public schema minimum 6 never authorizes an Admin short password.

PasswordResetRequest.description: Server derives role from the valid one-time token; no valid local list means safe pause without consuming token. Reset revokes sessions/derived grants and increases the sole security_epoch, never clears MFA or logs in.

new_password.description: New password: 6-1024 Unicode code points for Student; server-derived Admin role requires at least 12. No composition requirement, trimming, normalization or truncation. Local approved password list required. Public schema minimum 6 never authorizes an Admin short password.

PasswordChangeRequest.description: Server derives role from current validated account. Candidate password must match the server-keyed reauth commitment; no valid local list pauses before proof consumption or success receipt.

RecoveryCodes.description: One display, no-store, digest storage only. Existing rotateRecoveryCodes route explicitly creates a first group after full login or rotates an existing group; manual/automatic recovery final and status never return this model. Lost first response: 409 SECRET_ALREADY_ISSUED; fresh reauth and a new explicit operation rotate/invalidate the old group, never replay plaintext.

ReceiverPublicKey.description: Public JWK only. Reject private/extra fields; mature crypto must verify canonical base64url coordinates and an on-curve public point. No hardware quantity is mandated.

ReceiverProof.description: P-256 ECDSA SHA-256 with 64-byte IEEE-P1363 r||s signature encoded as canonical unpadded base64url. Sign the domain-separated method/path/Idempotency-Key/flow-or-login-challenge/receiver-thumbprint/challenge/body commitment defined in HTTP-SESSION-CONTRACT.md; all request fields except receiver_proof are covered. Challenge is server-issued, current, bound to the login/recovery receiver context and single-use; the signature binds the exact action/path. Client time is not authority.

AutomaticRecoveryContext.description: Only the automatic recovery receiver context: distinct CSRF/key proof and cookie, no ordinary user/device/session authority. Flow expiry is bounded and never extended by challenge refresh.

candidate_parameters.description: Future write Idempotency-Key and exact strict body, not the reauth request key. Server computes and stores a purpose-separated keyed commitment; no raw secret/ordinary SHA is persisted or returned.

oneOf.description: Independent read-only proof for the original stable executor only. Local broker rechecks current Admin/MFA/session/device/epoch and dedicated permission, stored executor, own case/op, StatusPlan and durable operation facts. It does not require the target current role/epoch, old issue proof or verification details already minimized under policy. Insufficient durable facts remain unknown. No public manual action or recovery write is executed here.

ReauthOperation.description: Closed reviewed purpose set; no arbitrary operation/role/risk or parameters. Target and candidate body are strict. No generic proof for admin/cache/unreviewed routes. Stored server HMAC covers exact validated typed parameters plus current subject/session/device/epoch and operation identity; do not echo a low-entropy password fingerprint.

RecoveryReceiverRequest.description: Only automatic flow. Valid restricted cookie, its CSRF, exact Origin, current target epoch/flow, current password verification and fresh receiver-key PoP are all required. Server records actual verified_at and an operation-specific deadline at most verified_at+120s, intersecting flow/current qualification expiry; recheck after all locks. No new-password minimum, lost old MFA, second recovery-code consumption or flow-TTL extension. Not a manual receiver protocol.

RecoveryReceiverEnrollment.description: Pending seed to the bound automatic receiver once, no-store. Old factor remains active. A separately authorized fresh PoP reissue rotates pending seed/generation without extending original flow expiry; never replay old URI from generic receipt.

RecoveryReceiverConfirm.description: Reverify current password, fresh receiver PoP and new TOTP for the currently bound automatic flow/enrollment. Record actual verified_at and a fixed operation deadline at most verified_at+120s, intersect flow/current qualification expiry and recheck clock_timestamp after all locks. Consume challenge/cap atomically with final switch; no lost old MFA, second recovery-code consumption or flow-TTL extension. Manual cases are rejected even if identifiers resemble a flow.

RecoveryCompleted.description: Non-secret completion fact only. Atomic factor replacement, old code-group invalidation, sole epoch increment and full derived-authorization revocation; no session, seed, codes or terminal-status capability. Clear recovery cookie. Full password plus new MFA login is required.

x-pr03b-authentication.status: S2 review candidate; S1 APPROVE is not S2 or S3 approval
x-pr03b-authentication.scope: auth, personal session/device security and WS authentication only; no public manual recovery control API
x-pr03b-authentication.server_principal: Validate cookie digest, active user, server role, sole users.security_epoch, live session/device, factor level and both deadlines; never trust client owner/role/epoch or fall back to OwnerContext.
x-pr03b-authentication.authorization_transaction: Lock and recheck current authority in the same short transaction as the protected write; check clock_timestamp after all lock waits. Revocation notifications only accelerate invalidation.

cookie.name: __Host-classroom_session
cookie.contents: opaque random token; server stores purpose-separated digest only

student.remember_me: Only controls cookie persistence; never changes server deadlines.

admin.mfa: mandatory; recovery codes never grant ordinary admin access
admin.remember_me: Always a non-persistent cookie even when true.

x-pr03b-authentication.session_rotation: Login, completed MFA and security elevation rotate token/CSRF. Rotation and activity never extend the original logical absolute deadline. Only full login starts a new logical session.
x-pr03b-authentication.origin_csrf: Browser writes require exact configured HTTPS Origin, bound CSRF and Fetch Metadata checks. Missing/null Origin is rejected; no wildcard credentials or suffix matching. Non-browser manual control is a separate local protocol, not a browser-auth exemption.
x-pr03b-authentication.password_text: Count Unicode scalar/code points, reject malformed UTF-8/unpaired surrogates/duplicate JSON member names; no trim, normalization or truncation. Login/reauth verify existing PHC without applying new-password minimum.
x-pr03b-authentication.password_list: Local-only screening on register/change/reset. No valid approved list: 503 SERVICE_DISABLED, retryable true, before reset/reauth proof consumption or success receipt; normal existing-password login continues with MFA and admission checks. Recheck approved list version at commit.
x-pr03b-authentication.reauth_binding: Opaque server proof binds current user/session/device/security_epoch, verified factors and actual verified_at plus strict operation purpose/target, future Idempotency-Key and server-keyed canonical-parameter commitment. No public password SHA, last_seen substitution or client-selected risk level.

raw_json_budget_s2_candidate.reason: reauth can contain both current and candidate 1024-code-point passwords; worst-case JSON escaping alone can exceed 24 KiB. This per-route S2 proposal does not change S1 source evidence or freeze production limits.

x-pr03b-authentication.manual_recovery: No public issue/complete/status endpoint. Student executor reauth may bridge a bound proof through a restricted FD to the local broker; project-user admin recovery uses independent authority credentials, never lost Web MFA.
x-pr03b-authentication.automatic_recovery: Password plus one recovery code yields only a receiver-key/cookie-bound automatic MFA rebind flow. No normal principal, classroom, export, admin operation, WS ticket or cache key. Enroll/reissue/confirm each reverify current password plus fresh receiver PoP (confirm also new TOTP), fix actual server verified_at and deadline at most 120s, and recheck after all locks; flow TTL never substitutes for fresh write proof. No lost old MFA or second recovery-code consumption. New receiver endpoints cannot handle manual flows.
x-pr03b-authentication.error_semantics: Generic authentication failures do not reveal account existence. RESULT_UNKNOWN never authorizes blind retry. Error code membership and HTTP status are checked together; no secret or private content in messages, logs or generic receipts.
